children: ConnectM Technology Solutions Inc. (CNTM) filed a Form 8K - Unregistered Sales of Equity - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on September 04, 2026.

The information set forth in Item 1.01 of this Current Report on Form 8-K regarding the issuance of the Note and the Warrants is incorporated herein by reference. The securities were offered and sold in reliance upon the exemption from registration provided by Section 4(a)(2) of the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, and Rule 506 of Regulation D promulgated thereunder. The Purchaser represented that it is an "accredited investor" as defined in Rule 501(a) under the Securities Act.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1895249/000110465926105542/tm2624767d1_8k.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1895249/000110465926105542/0001104659-26-105542-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
